name: St Mary's Close

layers.essential_history: [[c:Newer streets like this have grown around the old village core, but their names remember the church.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Nassington's population has grown from about 670 in 2001 to over 860 in 2021.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A goatherd says he saw a man in a Danish helmet hurrying towards the river with a small bundle.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head east, about 540 metres as the crow flies, to the Queen's Head. Head east to Station Road. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
